fx_rate_source: BoC 2024 annual average (fallback; live rate fetched from Frankfurter/ECB when available)
cost_basis_method_note: CRA requires Adjusted Cost Base (ACB) for identical properties (ITA s.47). ACB is a weighted average cost method: ACB per unit = total cost of all holdings / total units held. This tool's 'total_average' implementation matches CRA ACB computation.
tax_brackets_note: CRA 2024 federal income tax brackets. Source: https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/tax/individuals/frequently-asked-questions-individuals/canadian-income-tax-rates-individuals-current-previous-years.html. Note: provincial tax rates are additional and vary by province.

rates.inclusion_rate_note: Capital gains inclusion rate is 50%. Budget 2024 proposed increasing to 66.7% for gains exceeding $250,000 CAD, but this proposal was withdrawn in January 2025 and never enacted.

rules.superficial_loss_note: ITA s.54 'superficial loss': loss denied when same property acquired within 30 days before or after the sale, and still held at 30 days after.

references.title: CRA - Superficial losses (ITA s.54)
references.excerpt: A superficial loss occurs when you dispose of property at a loss and acquire the same or identical property within 30 days.
